title: Intraday Price Reversal Patterns in the Currency Futures Market: The Impact of the Introduction of Globex and the Euro
authors: Joel Rentzler; Kishore Tandon; Susana Yu
summary: 6E prices overlap one instrument; exact clocks/rules remain unread and broad gap/reversal families already have extensive negative selection history. No new test from a new title.
about: Currency-futures opening reversals and structural market changes.
findings: Indexed source studies seven currencies before/after Globex/euro; recent executable profitability has not been established.
mechanism: Opening information adjustment/liquidity could create reversal, but historical market-design changes can remove it.
build_on: 6E prices overlap one instrument; exact clocks/rules remain unread and broad gap/reversal families already have extensive negative selection history. No new test from a new title.

reading_scope: Indexed metadata only; no full paper read or exact family falsification claimed.
